questions.cardDe: In welchem Land findet man die größte Axt der Welt und den weltgrößten Hummer als Denkmal?
questions.de: In welchem Land findet man die größte Axt der Welt und den weltgrößten Hummer als Denkmal?
questions.en: In which country can you find the world's largest axe and the world's largest lobster as monuments?

timeline.labelEn: The World's Largest Axe is completed in Nackawic, New Brunswick, Canada
timeline.labelDe: Die größte Axt der Welt wird in Nackawic in der kanadischen Provinz New Brunswick fertiggestellt

questions.notes: Both are in the province of New Brunswick: the axe in Nackawic(-Millville), the lobster sculpture in Shediac (https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Shediac).

questions.de: Welches Buch machte 1937 die Leser mit den Figuren Bilbo und Frodo bekannt?
questions.en: Which book introduced readers to the characters Bilbo and Frodo in 1937?

timeline.labelEn: J. R. R. Tolkien's The Hobbit is first published by George Allen & Unwin
timeline.labelDe: J. R. R. Tolkiens Der Hobbit erscheint erstmals bei George Allen & Unwin

questions.notes: Card error: Frodo does not appear in The Hobbit; he first appears in The Fellowship of the Ring (1954) per https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Frodo_Baggins. The intended answer (The Hobbit, 1937, with Bilbo) is unambiguous, so the wording is kept as printed.

questions.en: What is the name of the glow that organisms produce under the water's surface, similar to a firefly?

timeline.labelEn: Raphaël Dubois shows bioluminescence is an enzyme-driven oxidation of luciferin (late 19th century)
timeline.labelDe: Raphaël Dubois zeigt, dass Biolumineszenz auf der enzymatischen Oxidation von Luciferin beruht (spätes 19. Jahrhundert)

questions.notes: Dubois dating from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bioluminescence ("late nineteenth century"); "Meeresleuchten" is also acceptable for the plankton glow at the sea surface.
